entity.name: PowerDataChat
entity.description: PowerDataChat is an AI assistant for Excel spreadsheets. Chat with Excel files to create analysis, charts, visualizations, and reports. The LLM generates Python code; the backend Python engine executes it for correct, computed results that scale with dataset size.

offerings.name: AI Excel Assistant
offerings.description: Upload Excel files and chat with your data using natural language. The AI writes Python code to analyze your spreadsheet; the Python execution engine runs the code and returns computed results. Works on large datasets because the Python engine processes the data, not the LLM.
features: Chat with Excel spreadsheets in natural language
AI generates Python code for data analysis
Python engine executes code for accurate results
Generate charts and visualizations from Excel data

summary.tagline: AI Excel Assistant powered by Python
summary.one_liner: Chat with Excel files. AI writes Python; Python engine executes it for correct results.

differentiators: Python execution engine runs LLM-generated code; results are computed, not hallucinated
LLM is used to write code, not to guess results from data
Scales with large datasets because Python processes the data
No formulas or coding required from the user
Generates charts, BI insights, and reports as outputs of Excel analysis
use_cases: Analyze Excel sales data with natural language questions
Generate charts and visualizations from spreadsheets
Get BI-level insights without technical expertise
Create shareable reports from Excel files
